study: May, Sirinides, Gray & Goldsworthy 2016 (Reading Recovery i3 scale-up, CPRE; ERIC ED593261)
delivery_evidence: Reading Recovery teacher training = a year-long graduate-level training course taught by an on-site teacher leader, with required weekly in-person classes (teachers reported traveling long distances to weekly classes) plus ongoing in-person PD; no online delivery (Method/teacher-training section; 'year-long graduate-level training course... required to attend weekly classes').
test_alignment_evidence: The included confirmatory outcome is the Iowa Tests of Basic Skills (ITBS) Total Reading, a broad independent standardized test; the program's own aligned Observation Survey (researcher_made) is flagged as non-independent and filtered out, so the included full-sample effect is distal/independent (Table 2.5, p.39-40).
curriculum_evidence: Reading Recovery is a specific standardized one-to-one literacy intervention program (12-20 weeks of daily 30-min lessons with its own approach/leveled-book materials) that teachers are trained to adopt and deliver as a supplement; control = regular classroom instruction (Intro/Method, 'individual, daily, 30-minute lessons provided by a Reading Recovery-trained teacher').
outcome_timing_evidence: ITBS measured immediately post-intervention (after the 12-20 week treatment, ~mid grade-1), pooled across the four study years; no post-treatment follow-up wave for the extracted effect (Table 2.5; report 'impacts estimated immediately post intervention').
